title: Infographic Spec: Anatomy of the Water Utility Ransomware Incident
headline: 90 Minutes to Contain, 9 Days to Fully Recover
subhead: How a contractor password became a regional water utility's worst week of 2024

sections.heading: Dwell Time
sections.body: The intruder authenticated on 4 September and stayed low-profile until 12 September.

sections.heading: Blast Radius
sections.body: Billing and the historian database were hit; control systems were segmented and spared.

sections.heading: Recovery
sections.body: Billing came back in four days from offline backups held at a separate site.

sections.heading: Root Cause
sections.body: The credential had also gone 14 months without rotation.

key_messages: Network segmentation kept a cyber incident from becoming a public health incident.
Third-party identity hygiene is the highest-leverage control for utilities.
Backups only help if attackers with domain admin cannot delete them.
colour_intent: Cool blues for the utility and its defences, a single alert red for the attacker path and the root-cause figure.
footer: Source: internal incident report IR-2024-0917. For Official Use Only.
